title: Heterogeneous-profile and cache-ownership qualification
blockers: The first production port built one adaptive table from cofgen(:,1) and applied it to all nodes, which is not valid for layered profiles with multiple hydraulic parameter sets.
The first production port used module-global SAVE cache state, which is not an acceptable unqualified ownership model for parallel MultiSWAP execution.

required_architecture.cache_ownership: provider/backend-instance local, no module-global mutable SAVE cache
required_architecture.material_identity: exact initialized 42-coefficient authority identity plus policy identity
required_architecture.profile_mapping: each node maps to a table built for its own exact hydraulic authority; equal materials share one unique table
required_architecture.analytical_fallback: per-node authoritative analytical provider outside the lookup domain
required_architecture.bind_reuse: provider-local cache survives repeated binds to the same backend instance

qualification: homogeneous F-AHL27 P1 result remains within frozen gates
mixed B01/O05 constitutive vector matches separate authoritative analytical node evaluations within representation gates
mixed profile uses exactly two unique material tables
repeated bind produces cache hits without additional builds
no module-level SAVE cache remains in production AHL provider/cache modules
O0/O2 compile and runtime identity for the bounded serialized route
